_doc: Street View corrections applied by tools/build-map.py on top of OSM. Add entries; no code changes needed.
buildings: keyed by OSM way id ("134101085"), relation id with an r ("r18783929"), or "new:<slug>" for a building OSM lacks.
lv: storeys (height = lv x 3.3 m x SCALE). t: office (glass tower) | block (concrete office/govt) | college | resi | shop | low.
colour: facade tint "#rrggbb". label: parody signage only (AGENTS.md: no real brands). n: name (null removes a bad OSM name).
hs: height source, default "sv" when lv is given; use "guess" if the floors weren't counted. drop: true removes the footprint.
new:<slug> needs a footprint: ll = [[lat, lon], ...] (preferred) or p = [[x, z], ...] in game units.
src: where the numbers came from and how the footprint was matched. Keep it honest about uncertainty.
pois: name -> {ll: [lat, lon]} or {osm: <node id in osm-pois.json / osm-streets.json>}, plus src.
Street View panos and satellite tiles are in research/streetview/img/ (gitignored); survey notes in research/streetview/*.md.

134101262.src: SOUTH.md §1: TIU main block, grey 2-storey podium, white-and-glass tower of 10-12 floors, rounded glass drum on the north end (sv01_tiugate_h288, sv01b_tiugate_fov60_h300). OSM w134101262 (building=college, 66x91 m) is the only footprint on the west side of Street 2 between 22.5756 and 22.5762; it lines up with the white building on sat275_a_tiu_pwc.

new:pwc-more-sw-tower.src: SOUTH.md §1/§3: new peach-and-glass tower of about 20-22 floors on the SW corner of PwC More, missing from OSM and from the (older) satellite, which still shows a vacant plot. Footprint: a 32x20 m slab parallel to Street 13, in the north part of that vacant plot on sat275_a_tiu_pwc (registered to OSM roads), west of Street 2 behind the blue hoarding, south of the west arm of Street 13, east of the service road at x=-40. Slab orientation from sv03_pwcmore_h296 (long face toward Street 13) and sv02_st2mid_h288 (seen end-on from Street 2). Exact plate size is a guess (+-5 m).

134101085.label: PWH
134101085.src: SOUTH.md §3: PwC office is a low white building of 2-3 floors with the sign on its parapet, behind a 2 m white wall on the NE corner (sv03_pwcmore_h026, sv03_pwcmore_h116). OSM w134101085 is tagged 'PWC Office' and its south tip is the building nearest the corner.

992001222.src: SOUTH.md §3/§4: 6-8 floor glass office with a telecom mast behind and east of PwC, also seen above the Electronics Complex police gate (sv03_pwcmore_h116, sv101_st13_h027). OSM w992001222 (office=private) is the footprint directly east of PwC; bearings from both panos point at it. Possibly the same tower the survey calls the police station's 7-storey tower.

new:ec-police-station.src: SOUTH.md §4: Electronics Complex Police Station, 40 m east of PwC More on the north side, a white low block inside a compound (sv101_st13_h027). Not in OSM. Footprint traced from the grey-roofed building under the 'ACP Traffic Office / Police Station' pins on sat275_a_tiu_pwc, east of w992001222. Floors not counted (1-2).

new:millennium-city-tower-1.src: SOUTH.md §4 (150-230 m): Millennium City IT Park, the front of two curved glass towers of about 13-14 floors, with the 2-storey podium holding the burger joint on Street 13 (sv104_st13_h027, sv104b_st13_h050). Not in OSM. Footprint fitted inside the OSM service-road loop west of the raised plaza, curved face toward the street, matching the large roof under the 'Netscribes / iMarque' pins on sat275_b_st13west (that tile is only registered to +-3 units here). The podium isn't modelled separately.

193475626.src: SOUTH.md §4: the rear curved glass tower of Millennium City (sv104_st13_h027, sv105_st13_h027). OSM w193475626 'Millenium City IBM DAKSH'; the bearing from the sv105 pano at the main gate points into it.

382403604.src: SOUTH.md §4 (about 110 m): run-down 5-storey peach residential-style block with a blue-glass stair tower by the side road north (sv103_st13_h027). OSM w382403604 is the building nearest the street at that distance on the north side.

986997144.src: SOUTH.md §4 (about 230 m): 5-storey grey office with blue glass bands east of the Millennium City towers (sv104b_st13_h050). Matched by position to OSM w986997144, east of the Millennium City service loop; low confidence.

986997145.src: SOUTH.md §4 (250-300 m): ERTL, a 6-storey white-and-blue-glass block set back behind a red-brown fence (sv106_st13_h027). OSM w986997145 sits under the 'Electronics Regional Test Laboratory' pin on sat275_b_st13west.

986997139.src: SOUTH.md §4 (360-400 m): the dhaba block, 5-storey tan concrete with horizontal sun-shade bands (sv108_st13_h027, sv109_st13_h027). OSM w986997139 is under the dhaba pin on sat275_c_st13east and is the nearest building to the street there.

238287187.src: SOUTH.md §4 (440-470 m): grey stone-and-glass tower of about 18-20 floors with the coffee chain at the kerb (sv110_st13_h027, sv111_st13_h027). OSM w238287187 is under the coffee pin on sat275_c_st13east.

238287188.src: SOUTH.md §4/§5: bank building on the NW corner of College More, white, about 8 floors, red portal columns, blue glass band (sv20_collegemore_h027). OSM w238287188 (building=office) is the NW corner footprint.

358887208.src: SOUTH.md §5: Signet Tower (DN-2), about 12 floors, yellow and glass, west side of Street 18 north of College More (sv22_st18north_h290). OSM w358887208 is under the Signet Tower pin on sat275_c_st13east.

new:college-more-ne-tower.src: SOUTH.md §5: a tall blue-green glass tower of about 20 floors on the NE corner of College More (sv20_collegemore_h027, right edge). No OSM footprint there and the satellite is older. Placed 28x18 m in the NE quadrant clear of Street 18, Street 13 and the corner service roads; position is the least certain of all entries (+-15 m).

134101300.src: SOUTH.md §5: IEM on the SE corner of College More, glass curtain wall of 6+ floors with a blue band (sv20_collegemore_h117). OSM w134101300 'Institute of Engineering and Management'.

r18783929.src: SOUTH.md §4 (300-430 m south side): Bose Institute unified campus, a big glass building of 8-9 floors with a stepped glass atrium (sv107-sv109_st13_h207). OSM relation r18783929 (multipolygon with a courtyard; geometry in osm-building-relations.json). Its round atrium lines up with sat275_c_st13east.

238287189.src: SOUTH.md §5: Fusion CX glass tower of about 12+ floors on the south side of Street 13 east of College More (sv21_st13east). OSM w238287189 is under the Fusion CX pin on sat275_d_college.

new:pwc-more-se-post.src: SOUTH.md §3: small blue 2-storey building with a black-and-white chequerboard band on the SE corner of PwC More (sv03_pwcmore_h116, sv101_st13_h207). Not in OSM; placed on the corner behind the footpath. Name unknown (police/traffic-guard post?).

new:ecocentre.src: Missing from OSM. Footprint traced on sat275_a_tiu_pwc under the 'Ambuja Neotia EcoCentre' pin (atrium-grid roof), south of the west arm of Street 13 and west of the service road at x=-40 (SOUTH.md calls it NW; registered against OSM roads it is SW of the junction, behind the new peach tower; d3_pwc_h270 agrees). Floors NOT counted: 8 is a placeholder until the north survey sees it.

new:altair.src: NORTH.md §1 (~50-90 m from PwC More, west side): a 12-14 floor glass tower with brown/pink spandrels close to the road behind palms and car parking (s13_01_h309, s13_02_h309). OSM has no footprint on the west side of Street 13 between the PwC corner tower and x=-100; the only candidate is the long slab traced on sat275_a_tiu_pwc under the 'AltAir - Capella' pin (was one 'new:altair' entry, 8 floors as a placeholder). Its east half is this tower: bearing from s13_01 to its east end is ~255 deg, at the left edge of the h309 view. Split at the midpoints of the long sides; the split line itself is a guess.

new:capella.src: NORTH.md §1 (~180 m from PwC More, west side): AltAir Capella-type brown-glass office tower of about 10-12 floors with salmon spandrels, royal palms and surface parking in front (g2_h219). It is the west half of the slab under the 'AltAir - Capella' pin (see new:altair): the bearing from g2 to its west end is ~200 deg, the tower at the left of g2_h219.

193478726.src: NORTH.md §1 (~180 m, east side): IIHM Global Campus, white, about 6-8 floors, behind the lunch-hotel shed (g2_h39, g2_h129; courtyard g1_*). OSM w193478726 is the nearest east-side footprint to the g2 pano (~19 units, 38 m) and fronts Street 13. Note OSM's 'Hotel Monotel' node sits in the neighbouring footprint w193478723, not here. Name left off (no real brand on screen).

158642186.src: NORTH.md §1 (~320 m, east side): cream/white tower of about 14+ floors with a rounded drum-shaped base behind a black iron railing, tea stall and kiosks on the footpath (s13_07_h39, wm_1_*). OSM w158642186 is the footprint straight ahead in s13_07_h39 (bearing ~42 deg, 16 units) and its outline is a curved crescent, i.e. the drum. NORTH.md guessed Hotel Monotel; OSM puts that node elsewhere, so the identity is unverified.

158019906.src: NORTH.md §2: the SE corner of Wipro More, a blue glass curtain wall with a red-framed residential section of about 12+ floors (s13_08_h39 right edge, s13_08_h129 left). OSM w158019906 is the next footprint east of w158642186 towards the flyover, at bearing ~87 deg from s13_08, which matches both views. Red tint for the red-balcony section; the blue glass half isn't modelled.

362948042.src: NORTH.md §1 (~320 m, west side) and §2 SW corner: red-brick-and-cream 5-6 storey block with a crowned parapet in a walled compound with big trees (s13_07_h219; Google label suggests a Ministry of Defence training centre, unverified). OSM w362948042 is the nearest west-side footprint to s13_07 (32 units) on the SW corner of Wipro More.

193479375.src: NORTH.md §1 (~280 m): tall pinkish-beige slab towers of about 14-16 floors further SW of Street 13 (s13_06_*). Matched by position: OSM w193479375 is the largest west-side footprint between Street 13 and the TIU plot, south-west of s13_06. Floors are a count from a distance; which slab is which is low confidence.

362948053.src: NORTH.md §1 (~280 m): the second pinkish-beige slab tower SW of Street 13 (s13_06_*). OSM w362948053 is the west-side footprint between w193479375 and the road, closest to s13_06. Low confidence (seen at distance only).

535333500.src: OSM w535333500 'IT Centre (Sector V)' (building=construction, construction:railway=station) is the Orange Line station box. It is drawn with the viaducts by src/render/world/stations.ts (NORTH.md §4), so the footprint must not also become a building.

237896675.src: The OSM name on this house is crude vandalism; don't ship it. Levels stay from OSM.

tiu.src: OSM amenity=university node for Techno India University (unchanged).

pwc.src: SOUTH.md §3: the PwC sign and white wall are right on the NE corner of PwC More; this is the street-facing south tip of w134101085 (moved about 30 m SW from the old point 22.57753, 88.42967).

burger.src: OSM fast_food node in the Millennium City podium (was hand-typed on the road centre line).
